text: The tickets were sold out. _____, we watched the game at home.

wrong.However: however 表示轉折，但票賣完與在家看比賽是因果關係，不是對比。
wrong.For example: for example 用來舉例，後面這句不是前一句的例子，而是結果。

why: 票賣光是原因，在家看比賽是結果，用 as a result。
tip: 表示結果用 as a result。
say: The tickets were sold out. As a result, we watched the game at home.

text: Some students like online classes. _____, others prefer face-to-face ones.

wrong.Therefore: therefore 表示因此，但兩種偏好並非因果關係。
wrong.In addition: in addition 表示「此外」，用來補充同方向的資訊，而這句是在說相反的偏好。

why: 兩句談相反的偏好，用 on the other hand 表示對比。
tip: 另一方面用 on the other hand。
say: Some students like online classes. On the other hand, others prefer face-to-face ones.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Besides of studying, she works part-time.

wrong.Besides of studying, she works part-time: besides 本身就是介系詞，後面不需要再加 of。
beside 是「在…旁邊」，要表示「除了…還有」要用 besides。

why: besides 表示「除了…之外還有」，後面接 V-ing。
tip: besides 是除了還有，beside 是旁邊。

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
options: 舉例來說，這個計畫失敗了

wrong.首先，這個計畫失敗了: first 或 first of all 才是「首先」，in short 不是用來開頭列點。
wrong.舉例來說，這個計畫失敗了: for example 才是「舉例來說」，in short 是做總結。

why: in short 表示「簡單來說、總之」，用來概括前面的內容。
tip: in short 用來做簡短總結。

text: Exercise keeps us healthy. _____, it helps us sleep better.

wrong.Nevertheless: nevertheless 表示儘管如此，但這裡是補充另一個好處，沒有轉折。
wrong.Instead: instead 表示「取而代之」，這句沒有替代的意思。

why: 兩句都在說運動的好處，用 moreover 追加說明。
tip: 追加同方向的理由用 moreover。
say: Exercise keeps us healthy. Moreover, it helps us sleep better.

prompt: 你正在寫作文的最後一句，想說「總而言之，手機有好處也有壞處」。哪一句最適合？
options: To sum up, phones have both benefits and drawbacks.
For instance, phones have both benefits and drawbacks.
By contrast, phones have both benefits and drawbacks.
answer: To sum up, phones have both benefits and drawbacks.

wrong.For instance, phones have both benefits: for instance 是舉例，但這句是整篇的結論，不是某個例子。
wrong.By contrast, phones have both benefits a: by contrast 用來對比，前面沒有相對的內容，不適合放在結尾。

why: to sum up 用在結尾，表示總結全文。
tip: 結尾總結用 to sum up。
say: To sum up, phones have both benefits and drawbacks.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: He was tired; however, he kept working.
He was tired, but however he kept working.
He was tired, although however he kept working.
answer: He was tired; however, he kept working.

wrong.He was tired, but however he kept workin: but 和 however 都表示轉折，重複使用，英文只需要擇一。
wrong.He was tired, although however he kept w: although 和 however 重複表示轉折，而且 although 引導的子句不能這樣連接。

why: however 連接兩個完整句子時，前面用分號或句點，後面加逗號。
tip: however 前用分號或句點，後加逗號。
say: He was tired; however, he kept working.

text: First, we need a plan. _____, we should find a team.

wrong.Instead: instead 表示取代，不是依序的下一步。
wrong.Otherwise: otherwise 表示「否則」，會讓句子變成威脅或警告，與按順序列出步驟不符。

why: first 之後接 next，表示按順序進行的下一步。
say: First, we need a plan. Next, we should find a team.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Take the bus. Otherwise, you will be late.
options: 搭公車吧，否則你會遲到
搭公車吧，其他人也會遲到
你搭公車的話就會遲到
answer: 搭公車吧，否則你會遲到

wrong.搭公車吧，其他人也會遲到: otherwise 在這裡是「否則」，不是 others（其他人）。
wrong.你搭公車的話就會遲到: 句意相反，otherwise 的意思是「不搭的話」才會遲到。

why: otherwise 表示「否則、不然」，指前面做法的反面。
tip: otherwise 是否則，後面接不好的結果。
say: Take the bus. Otherwise, you will be late.

text: Many teens use phones late at night. For _____, Amy checks messages until 1 a.m.

wrong.short: in short 才是「總之」，for short 不是固定連接語。
wrong.result: as a result 才表示結果，for result 不是固定說法。

why: Amy 是前一句的具體例子，用 for example 舉例。
tip: 舉例用 for example 或 for instance。
say: For example, Amy checks messages until 1 a.m.

prompt: 你想說「我姊姊愛派對。相反地，我哥哥喜歡待在家」。哪一句最適合？
options: My sister loves parties. In contrast, my brother likes staying home.
My sister loves parties. Therefore, my brother likes staying home.
My sister loves parties. For example, my brother likes staying home.
answer: My sister loves parties. In contrast, my brother likes staying home.

wrong.My sister loves parties. Therefore, my b: therefore 表示因果，但哥哥喜歡待在家並不是因為姊姊愛派對。
wrong.My sister loves parties. For example, my: for example 是舉例，但待在家和愛派對是相反的，不是例子。

why: 兩人喜好相反，用 in contrast 表示對照。
say: My sister loves parties. In contrast, my brother likes staying home.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Admittedly, the idea is risky; still, it is worth trying.
options: 雖然得承認這想法有風險，仍值得一試
這想法沒有風險，所以值得一試
這想法有風險，所以不該嘗試
answer: 雖然得承認這想法有風險，仍值得一試

wrong.這想法沒有風險，所以值得一試: 句中明說 the idea is risky，是有風險的。
wrong.這想法有風險，所以不該嘗試: still 表示轉折，後面說仍值得試，與選項的結論相反。

why: admittedly 先承認缺點，still 再轉到支持的看法。
tip: admittedly 先讓步，still 再轉折。
say: Admittedly, the idea is risky; still, it is worth trying.
